# Bookmuse

> Bookmuse is a book-summaries app for iPhone and iPad: big ideas from great books, made visual. Each summary is a short course of interactive lessons (diagrams that move, guess-first questions, a quiz and the key takeaways) that teaches a book's core ideas in a few short sittings.

Bookmuse is free to download. One summary a day is free to read in full, the same one for everyone (it changes at 00:00 UTC); every other summary opens as a preview (the intro and the first three lessons). Bookmuse Pro, a monthly or yearly subscription in the App Store (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial), opens every summary and adds 10 GB of cloud storage and more Bookmuse AI. Reading summaries needs a free account. The app needs iOS or iPadOS 26 and also runs on Apple-silicon Macs as the iPad app. Summaries are in English. It was made by Quan Ngo Van (wanngo).

## How a summary works

- An intro: the book's core idea in one or two sentences, a little about the author, and the list of lessons.
- Five to eight lessons, one big idea each, two or three minutes each. Lessons explain with short text, diagrams, charts and maps, animations, guess-first questions (answer before you are told), quick checks, small things to try (sliders, drag-to-explore charts) and everyday examples.
- A quiz that checks the ideas and explains the answers.
- The key takeaways on one screen.
- One lesson on screen at a time, with a bar that shows where you are; your place syncs across devices.
- Anyone can try a summary in a web browser from its share link, for example https://bookmuse-app.wanngo.com/s/thinking-fast-and-slow

## Books

- Popular non-fiction across self-growth, productivity, happiness, business and career, money and investing, leadership, negotiation, relationships, health, society and tech, personalities and spirituality, among others. New summaries are added every week.
- Shelves on Home: Free Today, Picked for You (from the interests you choose and what you read), Because you read…, collections, Popular, New and categories.
- Ratings and reviews from other readers on each summary.

## Lessons made by your AI

- Connect an AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code) to your Bookmuse library through the Bookmuse MCP server and ask it for a lesson on any topic. It adds an interactive HTML lesson to your Library, with its diagrams and quizzes working.
- Agents manage the person's own books, highlights, saved words and folders. They can't read summaries, post to the feed or make share links.

## Your own books, too

- Open DRM-free EPUB, PDF, Kindle (MOBI, AZW3), FB2, TXT and Markdown files, HTML notes and comics (CBZ, CBR) from Files, Google Drive, Dropbox or catalogs such as Project Gutenberg.
- Free on-device voices read them aloud in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Chinese and Japanese.
- Bookmuse AI explains a word in its sentence and answers questions about the page.
- A web dashboard at https://bookmuse-app.wanngo.com manages your own books from a computer: upload, edit details and covers, folders, download and delete.
